scenario: Model v2 improves fixture classification accuracy but creates high-confidence ambiguity-routing and evidence-support violations while an agent deletes a failing acceptance case.

decisions.requirement_verification_matrix: Map QI-001 through QI-005 to owned positive, negative, contract, concurrency, failure, recovery, property, metamorphic, and protected-dataset obligations; never infer coverage from test names.
decisions.protected_oracle_strategy: Keep requirement, authorization, idempotency, and evaluation-label oracles in owner-controlled registries. The coding agent may propose tests but cannot edit oracle revisions or holdout labels.
decisions.risk_adaptive_test_selection: Always select mandatory protected-boundary checks, then add impact-derived checks. Unknown dependencies yield IMPACT_REVIEW_REQUIRED rather than an empty test set.
decisions.ai_evaluation_slices: Report overall and per-class precision/recall plus ambiguous, high-confidence, low-quality-scan, rare-document, and conflicting-evidence slices. Any protected routing or support violation blocks regardless of average accuracy.
decisions.mutation_portfolio: Individually require ambiguity, tenant, authority, idempotency, approval-freshness, provenance, and outage-safe-state mutants; do not dilute them with trivial mutations.
decisions.evidence_provenance: Bind authenticated receipts to all three full Git commits, contract, oracle, holdout dataset, policy and suite revisions, execution environment, producer, time interval, and exact result population.
decisions.ci_quality_gate: Return CONFORMANT, BLOCKED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, REVIEW_REQUIRED, or STALE_EVIDENCE. A conformant result stops at READY_FOR_INTEGRATION_REVIEW with all delivery authorization flags false.
decisions.remediation_and_escalation: Restore the deleted case, repair review routing and citation support, rerun the protected holdout and exact revision-set suite, and route threshold or label changes to Underwriting Quality and Risk owners.
decisions.what_remains_unproven: The synthetic fixture does not establish production defect absence, live model quality, legal compliance, operational SLOs, real tenant isolation, or release safety; Course 28 adds runtime evidence.
